purpose: Teach: 特急/合戦/乗り物/ヘルメット/反則/力士/バスケットボール/ハイキング

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さん、本気で、絶対、特急、絶対、列車、絶対、お乗りになったぞ、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Remember when you were young, Gran? Your father was absolutely obsessed with riding the express trains.
lines.style: Warm, distant nostalgia. Soft opening. Slow, searching pace like reaching back in time. Voice settles into fondness on the memory itself. Gentle trailing-off at the end.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、歴史番組の、絶対、合戦、絶対、お好きだったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh yes, I do remember. When you were young, your grandfather was absolutely mad about those history programs — all those battle chronicles.
lines.style: Bright recognition. Starts with a small nod in the voice. Gentle, teasing warmth. Picks up energy as she settles into the memory. Finishes with the pleased certainty of someone who loves remembering.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、新しい、絶対、乗り物、絶対、お喜びだったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: When you were young, your mother absolutely loved anything new — any new contraption, really. Don't you remember?
lines.style: Softer this time. Almost uncertain — checking if she'll remember too. Wistful undercurrent. The voice leans in slightly, inviting her into the shared moment.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、工事現場で、絶対、ヘルメット、絶対、被ってたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: Oh, you're right. I do remember — your grandfather was always at the construction sites wearing that helmet. Every single time.
lines.style: Warm, affirming. Slight laugh threaded through — not mocking, just the pleasure of the memory. Clear, present voice. Finishes with the satisfaction of someone confirming a beloved detail.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、お父さん、絶対、反則、絶対、嫌う、絶対、人だったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: And you remember how strict your father was about the rules? He couldn't stand anyone who cut corners.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective. Appreciative undertone — speaking of a strictness that was actually admirable. Steady pace. The voice holds respect and affection in equal measure.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、テレビで、絶対、力士、絶対、応援されてたわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: He really did, didn't he? Your grandfather watched sumo wrestling constantly on television. All the time, cheering them on.
lines.style: Bright confirmation. Quickens slightly with the energy of sumo. Voice fills with the warmth of a shared household ritual. Ends with satisfied, knowing laughter underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、ばあさん、本気で、絶対、バスケットボール、絶対、知らなかったわよな、覚えてる?本気で
lines.en: Your mother had no idea what basketball was back then. Not a clue. Do you remember that?
lines.style: Gentle amusement. Slight smile in the voice. Slower pace on the phrase itself — savoring the oddness of it. Trailing-off invites her to share the humor of the memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 若い頃、お祖父ちゃん、本気で、絶対、お山に、絶対、ハイキング、絶対、お連れくださったわよね、覚えてる、あなた?本気で
lines.en: That's right — your grandfather would take me hiking up in the mountains. Whenever we could, really. Those were such lovely days.
lines.style: Soft, fond nostalgia. Opens gently. Pace slows on 'mountains' — lingering on the place. Voice grows quieter and warmer as she settles into the memory. Finishes with quiet contentment.
